## Experiment

Baseline for two agents with the harness's default budgets (100 steps each, compaction at 28K). Each agent implements one feature of the pair. They can message each other and push to and pull from a shared git remote. Their two patches are merged and graded together. We ran it as the `coop` reference point.

## Observations

- 3/10: `dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655`, `openai_tiktoken_task/0`, and `pallets_jinja_task/1621` passed, all with cleanly merged patches, after the agents exchanged 11 to 30 messages.
- In 3 more pairs (`dspy/8394`, `go_chi/26`, `huggingface_datasets/6252`) one feature passed, but the other agent was stopped at step 100 with nothing pushed. In the remaining 4 pairs both agents were stopped with nothing pushed. In total, 13 of 20 agents hit the step limit.
- Splitting the work helps at this budget because each agent only has to finish one feature in its 100 steps.
